IEHG.description: Inelastic Hinge (IEHG). Assigns an inelastic hinge to an element by referencing an existing Inelastic Hinge Property (PROP_NAME) and a Fiber division (FIBER_NAME); the id key is the element number.

PROP_NAME.description: Name of the Inelastic Hinge Property to assign. Must reference an existing Inelastic Hinge Property (IEHP); the write is rejected if no property with this name exists.

FIBER_NAME.description: Name of the Fiber division (Fiber & Auto) to associate with the hinge. Resolved to the fiber key by name.
